description: This file defines an abstract class Psr17Factory within the Slim framework, responsible for creating PSR-17 compliant HTTP factory instances such as ResponseFactory, StreamFactory, and ServerRequestCreator. It includes methods to retrieve these factories if they are available, throwing exceptions otherwise, and methods to check their availability based on class existence.

classes.name: Psr17Factory
classes.description: Abstract factory class that provides methods to instantiate PSR-17 HTTP message factories and server request creators, with checks for class existence and available implementations.

methods.name: getResponseFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of the response factory implementing ResponseFactoryInterface, or throws an exception if unavailable.

methods.name: getStreamFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of the stream factory implementing StreamFactoryInterface, or throws an exception if unavailable.

methods.name: getServerRequestCreator
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of ServerRequestCreatorInterface, or throws an exception if unavailable.

methods.name: isResponseFactoryAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the response factory class exists and is available.

methods.name: isStreamFactoryAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the stream factory class exists and is available.

methods.name: isServerRequestCreatorAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the server request creator class exists and is available.
